role: Member of the Federal Council, Head of the Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sport (VBS/DDPS)
description: Elected to the Federal Council by the Federal Assembly on 12 March 2025 to succeed Viola Amherd; took office on 1 April 2025 and was assigned the defence department (defence, civil protection and sport).

role: Member of the Executive Council (Regierungsrat), Head of the Health Department
description: Cantonal minister responsible for the Health Department (Gesundheitsdirektion). Elected in a by-election on 17 January 2016 to succeed Peter Hegglin and re-elected with strong results. Served as Landammann (cantonal president) in 2021/2022 and Vice-Landammann in 2019/2020. As head of the Conference of Central Swiss Health Directors he had a prominent role in the cantonal COVID-19 response.
Member of the cantonal parliament of Zug, elected in 2006. From 2009 to 2012 he served as parliamentary group leader (Fraktionschef) of the CVP.

role: Managing partner (association management and non-profit consulting)
description: Managing partner responsible for association management and supervision of consulting dossiers for non-profit organisations, including mandates for feu suisse, the College for Naturopathy and Homeopathy (hfnh) and the Conference of the Colleges for Alternative Medicine (hfam).
Self-employed consultant in association management; managed consulting dossiers for non-profit organisations and book publications.
Employed as managing director of associations, including mandates for energie-agentur-elektrogeraete (eae), swiss automotive aftermarket (SAA) and Kueche Schweiz.

role: Lecturer / academic assistant, Contemporary History Department
description: Teaching assistant (1993-1996) and academic assistant (1997-2000) at the Contemporary History Department under Prof. Urs Altermatt, and lecturer in 2003. His thesis dealt with Federal Councillor Philipp Etter of Zug.
Held teaching positions at various levels, from primary school to baccalaureate school.
